summary: Basic sign-in is self-serve. Most useful APIs need LinkedIn to approve you for a product, and approval is not guaranteed.

verdict.label: Partner approval for most APIs
verdict.wait: Unclear. Could be weeks, and may be denied
verdict.reason: You can create an app and request some products quickly, but company-level or marketing APIs need approval, and LinkedIn can decline.

steps.title: Create or pick a LinkedIn Company Page
steps.detail: An app must be linked to a Company Page. Someone with admin rights on that page must verify the app.

steps.title: Create the app in the developer portal
steps.detail: Add app name, logo, privacy policy URL and the company page.

steps.title: Send the verification link to the page admin
steps.detail: The page admin must approve the app before it can use products.

steps.title: Request the products you need
steps.detail: Some products, such as sign-in with OpenID Connect, are available right away. Others require an application with a use-case description.

steps.title: Add redirect URLs and test
steps.detail: Add your HTTPS redirect URL and test the sign-in flow with your own account.

blockers.title: Product approval
blockers.detail: APIs for posting, marketing or community management need LinkedIn's approval and are sometimes limited to certain kinds of businesses.
blockers.what_to_do: Write a clear use-case description and ask only for the products you need. Have a fallback if you are declined.

blockers.title: Company Page dependency
blockers.detail: Without a Company Page and an admin who will verify, you cannot proceed.
blockers.what_to_do: Sort out page ownership before you start building.

agent_can: Draft the use-case description for each product
Check the redirect URL and scope format
you_must: Verify the app as page admin

checks_to_run: Create an app and write down which products are instant and which need an application
Confirm what happens if the Company Page admin is someone else
Check the source link still opens

generated.model: draft written from general knowledge, not from fetched pages
